author: free-law
description:
The Caselaw Access Project
	

In collaboration with Ravel Law, Harvard Law Library digitized over 40 million U.S. court decisions consisting of 6.7 million cases from the last 360 years into a dataset that is widely accessible to use. Access a bulk download of the data through the Caselaw Access Project API (CAPAPI): https://case.law/caselaw/
Find more information about accessing state and federal written court decisions of common law through the bulk data service… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/free-law/Caselaw_Access_Project.

author: docketx
description:
Georgia Case Law
	


Code & tools: github.com/docketx — legal-scrambler pseudonymises a case file on your own hardware before a frontier model sees it; claude-for-legal is the Claude Code plugin (docketx-open-law) that loads these datasets and checks citations against them.


	
		
	
	
		Source & credit — Free Law Project / CourtListener
	

Every opinion in this dataset comes from the Free Law Project / CourtListener bulk export of
